book_title: Realising The All (God?) Journeying into Feelings and Beyond
author: Winfried Sedhoff
book_description: As a young man, Winfried Sedhoff turned his back on a promising career as a medical specialist and isolated himself for months on end, exploring the far reaches of the mind and dimensions beyond. He wanted to understand more about the depression he carried, the realms beyond which most people choose to go, and ultimately, to experience the transcendent, which he calls 'The All'.He experienced an ecstasy so immense it was beyond description, a connectedness that had no boundaries. He was then faced with a continue to explore and gain more understanding across dimensions, or share this experience with the world. He chose to lead a regular life and study the problem from the inside. He was determined to find a way back to that transcendent state while still struggling with life's tumult, and give others a practical way to connect with The All.He later realised the path is in feelings - if we truly understand our feelings, use them as a tool and speak their language, we can come closer to realising The All. Filled with profound wisdom and understanding, this book is a step-by-step guide for those seeking to transform their lives, restore balance with nature, and live a richer, more meaningful existence.Show more
